Police are investigating the tragic incident and examining evidence from the hotel.

title: 'Meri galti nahi thi': Harbhajan Singh reveals why he was expelled from NCA
content: Harbhajan Singh went on to become one of India's most successful spinners. He represented India from 1998 to 2016 and finished his international career with more than 700 wickets across formats. He played 103 Tests and took 417 wickets, including 25 five-wicket hauls and five 10-wicket match hauls. In 236 ODIs, Harbhajan claimed 269 wickets, including three five-wicket hauls. He also played 28 T20Is and took 25 wickets.

title: Moody’s Mark Zandi: Strict immigration policies won’t mean more jobs for US workers
content: Economist Mark Zandi argues stricter immigration policies do not boost native-born jobs.  Native-born unemployment is now exceeding foreign-born worker rates.  Labor force participation has fallen while employers shed jobs.  A shrinking labor supply, driven by retirements and lower immigration, is a concern.  Businesses may reduce capacity and raise prices due to worker shortages.

title: ‘Non-negotiable’: T Dilip reveals what still sets Virat Kohli apart in the field

Dilip's most cherished moment was India's 2024 T20 World Cup victory in Barbados.  He also noted the fielding medal ceremony positively impacted the team's attitude.  Dilip's tenure saw India achieve significant success across various cricket formats.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued

Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.

title: Palau removed invasive rats; fish biomass jumped 183% in one year
content: A new study from Ulong Island in Palau has found the first experimental evidence that restoring seabird populations by removing invasive rats can also help nearby coral reefs recover. Within a year, researchers recorded more seabirds, increased nutrient movement from land to sea and higher fish biomass, showing that island restoration can benefit both terrestrial and marine ecosystems.

title: Anthropic has an important message for Claude users
content: Anthropic's Claude Code platform has announced that auto mode will now be the default setting for its users. This significant update enables the AI to tackle programming tasks autonomously, eliminating the need for pre-approval from developers. Tests reveal that auto mode surpasses human reviewers in safely detecting harmful actions. The feature seamlessly integrates with current services and offers the capability to control the user's screen as needed.

title: Trump Media Q2 results: US president-led media venture posts $238 m loss
content: In the second quarter, Trump Media faced a dramatic loss of $238 million despite seeing its revenue more than double. However, operating losses expanded significantly, prompting the company to abandon new ventures like online betting and cryptocurrency. Their focus has shifted to the Truth API service, aimed at trading firms, while a nuclear fusion project with TAE Technologies remains on track.

title: Sourav Ganguly receives death threats; Kolkata Police begin probe
content: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly has reported receiving threatening letters to the police.  His manager filed a complaint after two letters arrived with explicit threats.  The police are now investigating the source and motive behind these communications.  They are examining courier trails and tracking a mobile number for clues.  The investigation aims to identify the sender and ensure Ganguly's safety.

title: Oil prices hold near one-week high as Strait of Hormuz reopening remains in limbo
content: Oil prices are hovering near recent highs as prospects for a US-Iran agreement fade. On Tuesday morning, both WTI and Brent crude benchmarks experienced slight upticks. The situation is complicated by US demands for compensation, hindering the potential reopening of the crucial Strait of Hormuz. Iran insists that sanctions must be lifted for the vital waterway to function, amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions that are influencing market volatility and supply issues.

title: Trump admin has revoked over 1,75,000 visas since Jan 2025: Who is being targeted

Additionally, the administration is tightening rules that could affect international students and H-1B visa holders, indicating a significant shift in immigration policy.

title: Afghanistan qualify for 2027 ODI World Cup

They had already beaten Ireland by 92 runs in the second ODI, while the opening match of the five-match series was washed out. This will be Afghanistan's fourth appearance in an ODI World Cup.

This achievement surpasses Suriya's Karuppu by Rs 22 crore, showcasing Vijay's unwavering popularity among his loyal fans.
